data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that adds Daily video and audio calling capabilities.
data.what_it_does: Integrates the Daily Client SDK into Flutter apps, enabling real‑time video and audio calls. Exposes settings for codec, bitrate, adaptive layers and connection parameters.
use_when: You need to build video/audio calling with Daily's backend
Cross‑platform Flutter app targeting Android and iOS
You want built‑in adaptive bitrate and codec selection
avoid_when: You prefer a self‑hosted WebRTC solution
You don't want to depend on Daily's service
You need a pure Dart implementation without native code
strengths: Full Daily SDK feature set (codec, bitrate, adaptive layers)
Supported on both Android and iOS (CocoaPods & SwiftPM)
Simple Flutter API for call management
data.setup_notes: Add camera and microphone permissions (AndroidManifest, Info.plist). On iOS choose CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager. Run flutter pub get and rebuild the app.
